class.name: FSPropertyDescriptor
class.brief_description: A read-only structured descriptor for a single reflected [FoundryScript] member variable.
class.description: Describes one member variable declared by a [FoundryScript] type or its base scripts, as a typed alternative to the loosely-keyed [Dictionary] entries of [method FSReflection.get_properties]. Instances are produced by [method FSReflection.get_property_descriptors] and are immutable snapshots of the compiled property metadata. Beyond the [method Object.get_property_list] fields it mirrors ([member name], [member type], [member class_name], [member hint], [member hint_string], and [member usage]), each descriptor carries the variable's passive [member annotations]. The accessors return copies, so mutating them does not change the script's stored metadata. Use [method to_dictionary] to obtain the equivalent loosely-keyed descriptor [Dictionary].

method.name: to_dictionary
method.description: Returns the equivalent loosely-keyed property descriptor [Dictionary], matching the entries of [method FSReflection.get_properties]: an [method Object.get_property_list] [Dictionary] plus an [code]"annotations"[/code] key holding the [member annotations].

members.member: The passive annotations applied to the member variable, in source order, as [FSAnnotation] descriptors. Empty when the variable has no annotations. Each call returns an independent snapshot.
The property's class name, as in an [method Object.get_property_list] entry. Empty unless the property's type carries a class.
The property's hint, one of the [enum PropertyHint] values.
The property's hint string, paired with [member hint].
The property's usage flags, a bitmask of [enum PropertyUsageFlags] values.
